pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with smooth-gradient edges and rounded vertices. Spatial area is largest in the mid-flank region, exhibiting predominantly quadrilateral and pentagonal geometries with low-frequency edge perturbations.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a clear topological mesh. Junction nodes consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively high and uniform across the visible flank.
